summary: Phase 1 Bundles/Sets feature — BACKEND + FRONTEND both VERIFIED. Backend: wrote /app/backend/tests/test_bundles.py covering 14 pytest cases against https://toolbox-vault-v3.preview.emergentagent.com — ALL 14 PASS (100%). Verified: POST /api/bundles (200, persisted name/part_number/set_price), GET /api/bundles (returns item_count + slim photos), GET /api/bundles/{id} (returns items[] array with embedded Tool docs), PUT /api/bundles/{id} (name+price persist on subsequent GET), POST /api/bundles/{id}/items/{tool_id} (sets tool.bundle_id, item_count reflects), DELETE /api/bundles/{id}/items/{tool_id} (clears bundle_id, removed from items[]), DELETE /api/bundles/{id} cascade (returns ok:true + deleted_items:N, attached tools GET 404 after cascade), POST/PUT /api/tools with bundle_id field persists. Edge cases: 404 on missing bundle, 404 on attach-to-missing-bundle, 404 on attach-missing-tool, 404 on delete-missing-bundle. Auth via /api/auth/login (mechanicltz@gmail.com) with Bearer token — all bundle endpoints behind get_current_user. Frontend (Expo web @ login-stretch-layout, mobile viewport 390x844, BUILD 025 v2.1.1): VERIFIED via Playwright — (1) logged in with email/password form, landed on dashboard with bottom tabs DASHBOARD/INVENTORY/CONTACTS/CLAIMS/VAULT. (2) Tapped VAULT tab → 'Sets & Bundles' row visible under ORGANIZATION (testID=more-bundles). (3) Tapped more-bundles → /bundle list opened with empty state placeholder. (4) Tapped add-bundle-fab → /bundle/edit opened with NEW SET banner, form fields (bundle-name-input, bundle-part-input, bundle-price-input, bundle-notes-input), photo buttons, and ADD ITEMS card. (5) Filled name='TEST_UI Socket Set', part='UI-SS-100', price='123.45'. Tapped bundle-add-items-btn → modal opened with 1 pickable item (testID=pick-item-{tool_id}, 'Test Drill'). Tapped it (pick-item-7c72e80a-8b78-4023-85c6-1269294f5594), tapped DONE. ITEMS IN THIS SET shows '1' with the Test Drill row. (6) Tapped bundle-save-btn → POST /api/bundles created bundle 61698b34..., then POST /api/bundles/{bid}/items/{tid} attached tool; routed back to /bundle list — new card visible (testID=bundle-card-61698b34...) showing 'TEST_UI Socket Set / #UI-SS-100 · 1 item / $123.45'. (7) Tapped the card → /bundle/61698b34... opened with SET DETAILS banner; shows name, UI-SS-100 pill, '1 item' pill, SET PRICE $123.45 row, ITEMS TOTAL (individual) $0.00 row, ITEMS IN THIS SET section with 'Test Drill $0' row, DELETE SET & ALL ITEMS button (testID=bundle-delete-btn) rendered with danger border + trash icon. (8) Inventory FAB AddChooser flow was NOT VERIFIED LIVE in this session (login rate-limit hit 5/min on 3rd browser run), but the code is verified by inspection: inventory.tsx:1321 renders AddFab testID='add-item-fab' onPress={()=>setShowAddChooser(true)} and AddChooser.tsx renders testID='add-choose-item' (→ /tool/edit) and testID='add-choose-bundle' (→ /bundle/edit); inventory.tsx:1126-1129 renders the IN SET badge when item.bundle_id is set. (9) Cleanup: detached Test Drill from bundle and deleted bundle via API (deleted_items:0 since pre-detached). 0 bundles remain. Test Drill seed data preserved on mechanicltz account. No PAGEERRORs, no red screens. Console warnings observed: 'textShadow*' deprecated and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (Expo SDK noise, low priority).
action_items: No fixes required — Phase 1 Bundles/Sets verified passing on both backend (14/14 pytest) and core frontend flows (Sets & Bundles list, create, detail with cascade-delete button). Inventory AddChooser + IN SET badge flows verified by code inspection only (live test blocked by /api/auth/login rate limit 5/min after 3 browser runs); main agent or next testing iteration can spot-check these two flows visually if desired.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:2606-2691 — All 7 bundle endpoints have parity: create/list/get/update/cascade-delete/attach/detach. list_bundles correctly computes item_count via db.tools.count_documents({bundle_id: b.id}) and trims photos to first one (slim payload). get_bundle returns Tool models with photos trimmed to [0:1] and documents/receipts cleared — good payload-size discipline.

backend/server.py:2654-2666 — delete_bundle cascade: deletes tools.delete_many({bundle_id}) AND warranty_claims.delete_many({tool_id:{$in:item_ids}}) before db.bundles.delete_one — orphaned warranty claims cleanly removed too. Returns {ok, deleted_items} for UX feedback. Spec-compliant.

backend/server.py:749,807,844 — bundle_id: Optional[str] field on Tool, ToolCreate, ToolUpdate — all three branches present so POST/PUT/PATCH all accept and persist bundle_id (verified by test_create_tool_with_bundle_id_persists and test_update_tool_bundle_id_persists).

frontend/app/bundle/edit.tsx:94-121 — save() correctly handles isEdit branching: edit path calls updateBundle; create path calls createBundle then for-loops pendingItemIds via addItemToBundle. ItemRow remove handler at line 81 correctly forks edit (API call) vs new (state mutation). Modal at line 267-313 filters allTools by !t.bundle_id || (isEdit && t.bundle_id === id) to allow re-listing items already in this set.

frontend/app/bundle/[id].tsx:32-49 — onDelete uses confirm() with dynamic message including item count ('...AND all N items inside it'), passes destructive=true. Cascade-delete UX is correctly worded per product spec.
frontend/app/(tabs)/inventory.tsx:1126-1129 — IN SET badge is rendered inline when item.bundle_id exists (no extra API roundtrip needed since /api/tools includes bundle_id on each tool). Clean.

frontend/src/components/AddChooser.tsx — Bottom-sheet modal with two clear options (testID add-choose-item, add-choose-bundle) and a CANCEL. Routes are correct: /tool/edit and /bundle/edit. Touch targets ~64px tall (padding 14 + icon 44) — exceeds 44pt minimum.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (6/8 critical flows verified live, 2 verified by code inspection due to login rate-limit)
